name: Dolly Parton's Imagination Library
brand: Dolly Parton's Imagination Library (The Dollywood Foundation)
whatYouGet: A high-quality, age-appropriate book mailed each month to registered children at no cost to the family.
costDetail: Books are 100% free to enrolled children; local program partners cover book and shipping costs.
eligibility: Children (the US page refers to ages 0-5) living in an area covered by a local program partner; the check-availability page lets you register online or by mail where offered.
catches: Only available where a local program partner serves your address. One local program reported 8-10 weeks for the first book.
notes: Check availability by location first. The search-result snippet about 8-10 weeks came from a local program page.

name: 1000 Books Before Kindergarten
whatYouGet: A free reading challenge with reading logs and an app; many local library programs add small rewards at milestones.
costDetail: Reading logs and program instructions are downloadable; no cost listed for joining.
eligibility: Families with newborns, infants and toddlers; some libraries run local programs.
catches: Rewards depend on the local library; the site says to start at home if no local program exists.
notes: Directory by state; contact your local library to join.

name: Vroom Tips
whatYouGet: Free early-learning tips and activities for children 5 and under, via a free app, web app, and printable tips.
costDetail: Site describes the tips and tools as free.
eligibility: Parents and caregivers of children 5 and under.
notes: Page also mentions Vroom by Text and an Alexa skill. Account details were not read.

name: Free car seat inspection (Safe Kids / National CPS Certification)
whatYouGet: A one-on-one check by a certified child passenger safety technician who shows you how to install and use your car seat; Safe Kids coalitions host free inspection events.
costDetail: The page says coalitions host more than 8,000 free car seat inspection events; fees for individual technicians or locations were not confirmed.
eligibility: Anyone with a child car seat.
catches: Availability depends on local events and technicians; sessions take about 20-30 minutes and you do the installation yourself with guidance.
notes: Bring the car seat manual and vehicle manual. NHTSA's locator page returned Access Denied, so it was not read.

name: Carter's Rewards
whatYouGet: A free loyalty program for Carter's, OshKosh B'gosh and Skip Hop shoppers that includes a Birthday Surprise offer for each child.
costDetail: Described in search results as a free loyalty program.
eligibility: Birthday offers cover up to five children age 14 or under; search results say a recent purchase and promotional-email opt-in are needed.
catches: A 20% welcome offer is tied to the Carter's credit card. Offers are discounts, not free items; birthday offers need a purchase within 12 months.
notes: carters.com returned a bot challenge to the fetch helper, so this is based on carters.com search results only.
